name: Suresh Kumar Nayak/ସୁରେଶ କୁମାର ନାୟକ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Suresh Kumar Nayak's poems in Kabita Live bring the language of everyday encounters into scenes of longing and self-questioning. In ‘ବାଲିଯାତ୍ରା’, the fair's stalls, balloons, food and music become an inventory of hopes and disappointments. The speaker wanders through the crowd imagining a meeting with Anupriya, before returning to the ordinary consolation of a song and a packet of peanuts.

‘ଡର’ moves into a more intimate conversation. Flowers, traces of turmeric and images from the chariot festival accompany feelings that remain unspoken. Fear becomes both a defence and an obstacle to speech, until the poem turns its question inward. Across these two works, familiar pleasures sit close to loneliness and uncertainty.
